title: C1-smooth quadratic pressure-profile reconstruction from existing Wb/Wt/H state
question: Can a single physically admissible C1-smooth pressure-head profile constrained by the existing bulk and terminal storages reduce the gradient-dominant B9 qi error without sacrificing qH, adding prognostic state, or fitting to response?

candidate.name: C1_QUADRATIC_STORAGE_PROFILE
candidate.coordinate: x = H-z, distance upward from the water table; x=0 at the water table, x=L=H-anchor at the fixed anchor
candidate.rationale: Two existing independent storage constraints determine the two profile-shape parameters; pressure and derivative are continuous because one profile spans both lower subdomains.

reconstruction_solver.method: deterministic bounded nonlinear root via scipy least_squares on nonnegative pressure values psi_i=psi(d) and psi_anchor=psi(L), converted uniquely to a,b
fixed_multistart: piecewise-linear state seed from existing B9 terminal and bulk reconstructions
half of the piecewise-linear pressure seed
reconstruction_solver.uniqueness_rule: All converged physically admissible starts at a state must agree in a,b within 1e-8 relative/absolute combined tolerance. Otherwise the state is AMBIGUOUS_RECONSTRUCTION and C4I is blocked.

cases.reference: same immutable A2 Reference used by B8/B9/C4H

comparison.baseline: B9 TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR using the same projected Wb/Wt/H state and trapezoidal endpoint averaging
comparison.qi_support_rule: For each width and each moving history WT_RISE and WT_FALL, candidate qi must have strictly lower RMS and MAE than TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR and no greater sign-mismatch count.
comparison.qH_noninferiority_rule: For each width and WT_HOLD/WT_RISE/WT_FALL, candidate qH must have RMS and MAE no greater than TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR within 1e-12 and no greater sign-mismatch count.

decisions.QUADRATIC_STORAGE_RECONSTRUCTION_SUPPORT: All candidate states pass hard gates, qi support holds for both widths and both moving histories, and qH is noninferior for both widths across HOLD/RISE/FALL.
decisions.QI_IMPROVES_QH_TRADEOFF: All hard gates pass and qi support holds for both widths/moving histories, but qH noninferiority fails in at least one case.
decisions.QUADRATIC_RECONSTRUCTION_MIXED: All hard gates pass but qi support is not uniform across width/direction.
decisions.C4I_RECONSTRUCTION_BLOCKED: Any storage, uniqueness, physical-domain, hydrostatic, cross-quadrature or predecessor hard gate fails.

pre_execution_solver_clarification.rule: At least two of the four frozen starts must converge to physically admissible roots at both 64- and 128-point quadrature. All valid roots at a given quadrature must satisfy the frozen a,b uniqueness tolerance. A single surviving root is insufficient evidence of identifiability.
